info.title: CS-VB Line Endings Normalizer
info.description: Normalizes line endings (CRLF / CR / LF) in your C# or VB.NET source-code files.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
│   This application normalizes line endings (CRLF / CR / LF) in your CS and VB files.    │
│   them directly with the requested canonical line ending style to ensure consistency.   │
│   supporting UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32, either with or without a Byte Order Mark (BOM). │
│   This program is distributed 'as-is', without any warranty; Use it at your own risk.   │
│   Ensure to make a backup of your CS/VB files before running this application.          │

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Recursively process source-code files in all subdirectories.

options.name: --test
options.description: Runs the application in Test Mode (dry-run), simulating the entire process without modifying actual files.

arguments.name: DIRECTORY_PATH
arguments.description: The path to the root directory containing the *.cs or *.vb source-code files to process.

arguments.name: LINE_ENDING_STYLE
arguments.description: The target line ending formatting style to apply. Valid values are: CRLF, LF, CR
